completionSentence: 사용자는 T5 전체 상태를 암호화 백업해 다른 컴퓨터의 격리 상태에 복원하고, 비밀과 외부 계정만 다시 연결한 뒤 미완료 Work를 외부 효과 중복 없이 이어간다.
qualified: Idle Runtime maintenance closes new admission without silently cancelling active Work.

Session, Conversation, Work, Run, Memory, Automation, Artifact, Capability, Connection metadata, Messenger runtime, Terminal output, Activity, Runtime continuity and user-note components share one generation manifest.
Every included file is a portable relative exact regular file with size and SHA-256 verified before and after staging copy and once again before generation close.
The generation manifest and payload are encrypted together with scrypt and AES-256-GCM; wrong password exposes no manifest content.
Platform credential plaintext, model connection secrets and Messenger credentials are not registered or restored.
Large or cumulatively oversized non-core payload files retain bytes and digest as excluded_large and become explicitly unavailable after restore.
Wrong password, partial bundle, ciphertext change, unsupported version and relationship failure change zero destination bytes.
Restore materializes into an isolated sibling, validates component order and T5 Session-Work-Run-Automation-Artifact-Messenger relationships, then schedules activation only after Runtime stop.
A real resident Runtime atomically activated the prepared state, restarted on the restored state and preserved the replaced state as a rollback sibling.
A restored dispatch_claimed external delivery becomes unknown with blind sends equal to zero.
Settings provides encrypted whole-backup download, backup upload, password validation, restore restart and rollback without exposing internal paths.
Restore and rollback state that provider copies, external-service copies and separate backup files are not changed or deleted.
notClaimed: Copying Keychain, DPAPI, OAuth or Messenger secret plaintext
Availability of excluded_large artifacts after restore
Deletion of provider, external-service or separately stored backup copies
Physical cross-device macOS or Windows migration qualification
